source.snippet: I am getting frequent overload errors (http 529) in two separate sessions. 10/10 attempts failing. I am on Eastern US time. (Thread: 'Looks like Claude is down anyone else')

problem_statement: Developers and businesses relying on the Claude API as a production dependency face unplanned outages and overload errors (HTTP 529) with no in-band fallback or automated rerouting, causing revenue-impacting downtime.
target_segment: Software developers and product teams at startups and SMBs that use Claude API as a core inference layer in paid products.
notes: Paying API customers (Pro/API tiers) are the explicit buyer. Pain is lost revenue during outages. A multi-provider LLM proxy or circuit-breaker-as-a-service that auto-routes between Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini when one returns 529/overload could address this. Single thread; signal_strength 2 pending broader corroboration.
